desc:
Customer support reports and top questions show what is really happening in your inbox. Ecom Swift LLC pulls your ticket and chat data into a clear report with volume, speed and answer rates, plus one suggested action beside every chart.

## What is a customer support report?

A customer support report summarizes your tickets and chats over a period. It counts how many messages arrive, on which days and channels, what customers ask about most, how quickly you reply and how many questions were answered without a person. Our reports add a plain sentence on what each chart means and one action to try.

## Why unmeasured support stays stuck

Without numbers, support runs on impressions. The inbox feels busy, but you cannot tell whether Mondays are the problem, whether delivery questions are rising or whether replies are getting slower. Decisions about staffing, help articles and automation are guesses.

Data you already own usually sits unused in the help desk, because exporting and cleaning it takes time. A report that is ready to read turns that dormant data into decisions you can take this week.

## How reports lead to better decisions

A top questions list shows which topics cost you the most time. If a large share of your messages ask where an order is, an order status page or helper is worth building before anything else. If one product causes repeated sizing questions, the product page needs a better size guide.

Reply and resolution times show whether customers wait too long. Peak hours show when extra cover is needed. The share of questions answered without a person shows how much your automation really does. These pictures allow you to spend effort where it saves the most time, though results still depend on your own follow-through.

## What a useful support report includes

- Message volume by day and by channel.
- A ranked list of the most common question topics.
- First reply time and time to resolution.
- The share of questions answered without a person.
- Trends by week, so you can see direction and not only a snapshot.
- Peak hours and quiet hours for staffing.
- Gaps between questions asked and help articles available.
- A plain summary with clear actions.
- Charts in a file you can share with your team.
- An optional live dashboard in a tool you choose.

## How we build it

We start by agreeing which questions the report must answer. You give us an export or read-only access to your help desk, inbox or chat history. We clean the data, group messages into topics, calculate the measures and write the commentary.

The Basic package delivers a report for one month with volume, top topics and a short summary. The Standard package covers a longer period with speed, answer rates and weekly trends in a shareable file. The Premium package covers the longest period, adds a live dashboard, links top questions to missing articles, shows peak hours and ends with a results call. Customer satisfaction can be included where your tool already records it.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Decide what you want to learn before we start.
- Share your channels and opening hours.
- Pick a couple of findings per cycle and work on those first.
- Compare reports month to month.

**Avoid:**
- Judging staff on a single number.
- Mixing test tickets with real ones.
- Chasing every chart at once.
- Ignoring topics that look small but repeat daily.
- Sharing exports that contain more personal data than needed.

## Who it suits

A store owner who feels overwhelmed by support but cannot say why. A team lead who needs figures for a staffing or tool decision. A founder who wants to know whether an automation is helping.

## What we need from you

An export or read-only access to your tickets or chats, and your opening hours. We never need passwords. Tell us what decisions the report should support, and we will shape the sections around them.
